[Notes](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AvjX5mvHd_OlzAWSIZ96AWAqbevXwI6koWyGBnOOdi4/edit)
in Google Docs.

Jung, like [Freud](freud.qmd), is about constructing narratives and telling
stories. The [Stories](../concepts/stories.qmd) note collects the other sources
on that idea.

## Books by Jungian Writers

- [Ego and Archetype](../books/ego-and-archetype.qmd). Edward F. Edinger.
- [The Problem of the Puer Aeternus](../books/puer-aeternus.qmd). Marie-Louise
  von Franz, a Jungian analyst and a collaborator of Jung.
- [Finding Meaning in the Second Half of Life](../books/second-half-of-life.qmd).
  James Hollis, a Jungian analyst.
